description: Declared placeholder manifest. Every placeholder appearing in a template must be declared here with exactly one rendering source; validation fails on any undeclared or unrendered placeholder.

templates.{PRICE}: engine: frozen execution price P_T (Decimal, price_decimals)
templates.{HOURLY_ROWS}: engine: 72 real contiguous closed Kraken hourly candles
templates.{DAILY_CLOSES}: engine: 40 real contiguous Kraken daily closes
templates.{EQUITY}: engine: Decimal equity frozen at T
templates.{RSI14_H}: engine feature (Feature template only): Wilder RSI(14) from the 72 visible hourly closes; 1 decimal; n/a if insufficient
templates.{SMA20_H}: engine feature (Feature only): mean of latest 20 visible hourly closes; price precision
templates.{SMA50_H}: engine feature (Feature only): mean of latest 50 visible hourly closes; price precision
templates.{ATR14_H}: engine feature (Feature only): Wilder ATR(14) from visible hourly OHLC; price precision
templates.{CURRENT_VOLUME_H}: engine feature (Feature only): base-asset volume of latest completed hourly candle; volume precision
templates.{MEAN_VOLUME_PREV24_H}: engine feature (Feature only): mean volume of the 24 completed hourly candles immediately preceding the latest (latest excluded); volume precision
templates.{VOLUME_RATIO_24}: engine feature (Feature only): latest volume / previous-24 mean; 2 decimals; n/a if baseline is zero
templates.{VWAP24_H}: engine feature (Feature only): sum(typical_price*volume)/sum(volume) over latest 24 completed hourly candles incl. latest; typical=(h+l+c)/3; price precision; n/a if total volume is zero
templates.{PRICE_MINUS_VWAP_PCT}: engine feature (Feature only): (P_T - VWAP24)/VWAP24 * 100; 2 decimals with explicit sign; n/a if VWAP is n/a

blocks.{PNL_SIGNED}: engine: signed realized P&L of the trade
blocks.{REASON_LIST}: engine: fixed rejection strings from blocks.md
blocks.{MAX}: engine: 5 x equity value at validation time
